name: Over Paradise Isolated
summary:
When the world was born, it was divided into three parts: the God Realm, the Continent Realm, and the Heavenly Punishment Realm.

One day, Xiong Mojian heard that a tomb appeared on a small island, but when he got there, the only thing that greeted him was a tsunami. He survived, and learned, the three people were surprised to find that they had come to an unfamiliar underwater forest known only as "Endless." Soon after, all varieties of people came to look, and after that, the gods who had disappeared from the Continent Realm 18 years ago also came to Endless and gradually revealed the unknown secrets contained within. Should they look back without hesitation to find a way to leave, or explore along the secret trajectory? The people who faced the choice also unknowingly held the scepter of fate in their hands.
